title: Oscilloscoop met hoge bandbreedte
description: Aan de VUB B-PHOT werd een elektro-optisch karakteriseringsplatform ontwikkeld voor fotonische IC’s. Deze opstelling ondersteunt experimenten op nieuwe lasers en geïntegreerde systemen zoals multi-golflengte lasers voor telecom, LIDAR en neuromorfe toepassingen. Hoewel de huidige apparatuur diverse elektrische/optische I/O-combinaties ondersteunt in de optische C-band tot 50 GHz — inclusief topklasse afstembare lasers, eenkanaals arbitraire golfvormgenerator, real-time spectrumanalyser en een optische spectrumanalyser met ultrahoge resolutie — blijven beperkingen bestaan in intensiteit-fase (IQ) modulatie en tijdsdomein-acquisitie voor coherent detectie. Dit beperkt onze mogelijkheden om geavanceerde modulatieformaten en dynamische signalen te genereren en te analyseren. Wij vragen daarom een oscilloscoop met 50 GHz bandbreedte als essentiële uitbreiding. Samen met bestaande apparatuur maakt dit de generatie en karakterisatie van complexe optische of elektrische signalen mogelijk, in tijd én frequentie tot 50 GHz. Deze uitbreiding versterkt de bestaande infrastructuur, opent nieuwe onderzoekslijnen, en ondersteunt hands-on training voor studenten en samenwerking met academische en industriële partners.

title: RYDBERG ATOM-BASED ALL-OPTICAL RADIO-FREQUENCY RECEIVERS (ARTES 4.0 SL SPL 5H.010) EXPRO+
description: Objective: The objective of the activity is to design, develop, and test two IP cores that implement the transmitter and receiver digital functions of the coherent and non-coherent 10 Gbps air interface optionfrom the ESA Specification for terabit/s optical Links (ESTOL). The IP cores shall cover in scope both the optical inter-satellite links and the optical space-ground links included in ESTOL.Targeted Improvements:Develop non-coherent IP core to reach 10 Gbps from the current offering at 2.5 Gbps. Also, develop a coherent IP core to improve the sensitivity of the non-coherent one.Description:The activity shall design, develop, test two IPcore that implement the transmitter and receiver of the 10 Gbps coherent and non-coherent air interface options from the ESTOL. TheIP cores shall implement the data link layer of the transmit/receive devices, including randomization, FEC encoding/decoding, framing/de-framing, modulating/demodulating, CRC, digital synchronization etc. The IP cores shall encompass both optical inter-satellite links and optical space-ground links (bidirectional). For the latter, a time diversity method, as specified in ESTOL, shall be included in the IP. The IP cores shall be tested against software implementations of the ESTOL specifications and shall become part of the ESA IP core portfolio. It shall be implemented and tested in a commercial FPGA.

title: Gebäudeautomation
description: Gebäudeautomation für einen Neubau einer Universitäts- Bibliothek mit folgenden Leistungsumfang: Lieferung und Montage der Gebäudeautomationsanlage, bestehend aus DDC- Automationsstationen und Leistungsschaltschränke. title: Broadband Coverage in Europe 2022-2024 - CNECT-2021-OP-0081
description: The broadband coverage in Europe study is designed to monitor the progress of EU Member States in the deployment of different broadband networks. This report covers the EU 27, plus Norway and Iceland, and analyses the availability of ten broadband technologies (DSL, VDSL, VDSL2 Vectoring, cable modem DOCSIS 3.0, DOCSIS 3.1, FTTP, FWA, LTE, 5G and satellite) across each market, at national and rural levels. In addition, various combination categories indicating the availability of one or more forms of broadband connection are also published. These cover overall fixed broadband availability, next-generation access (NGA) availability and overall FTTP & DOCSIS 3.1 availability. Europe-wide overview, country comparisons and year-on-year trends are provided in this report, including country chapters.

title: Quality Assessment and Red Parcel management in the GSA and AMS for 2024-2027
description: In order to be able to execute the QA AMS, GSA and process the ‘Red Parcels’, the contractor will need to deliver the following products: 1)Transferring/handling of geospatial data such as Sentinel, Planet Fusion; 2)Make available a web-based viewer: the availability of a cloud in which all data can be accessed and production can run; 3)Computer Assisted Photo Interpretation (CAPI) environment; 4)Activities related to archiving of production data according to the conditions that are set by the European Commission. The scope of the Quality Assessment and the handling of 'red parcels' is to assess the quality of the information declared by the farmer as well as the quality of the automatic generated AMS-results. If a discrepancy is found between what the farmer declared or what the AMS yielded as a result and the information collected using remote sensing data, the application of the farmer will be modified accordingly and possible financial corrections can incur. All findings will be communicated to the scheme applicants. The communication will be facilitated through the RVO.nl platform hosted and provided by NEA.
